bull.b: Free cash flow of ~$3.5B in FY2026 and strong cash conversion provide durable internal funding for capex, R&D, dividends, and buybacks. That sustained cash generation improves financial flexibility, funds technology ramps and capital returns across mid-term cycles.

bull.t: Markedly improved balance sheet and leverage
bull.b: Debt reduction to ~$1.1B and a low debt/equity ratio materially lower refinancing and interest risk. The stronger capital structure supports multi-year investments, share repurchases/dividend programs, and resilience to demand downturns over the medium term.

bull.t: Advancing product roadmap and capacity leadership
bull.b: Progress on 40TB ePMR, ramp targets for UltraSMR and planned 44TB HAMR are structural advantages that lower cost/TB and increase supply for cloud customers. Sustained leadership in high-capacity drives supports durable share gains and aligns with long-term AI/cloud storage demand.

bear.b: The business swings from large losses to strong profits across cycles, meaning revenue, margins and cash flows can reverse quickly. This reduces predictability for capital allocation and makes sustaining dividends/repurchases and long-term planning more uncertain.

bear.t: Execution and ramp risk for new technologies
bear.b: Company performance depends on successful qualification and volume ramps of ePMR, UltraSMR and HAMR. Delays, yield shortfalls or longer qualification timelines could undermine cost/TB and margin targets, impairing revenue and profitability durability.

bear.t: Uncertainty in multi-year LTAs and pricing
bear.b: Ongoing negotiations for LTAs create uncertainty about realized pricing and contract structures. If final agreements lock in lower pricing or unfavorable terms, improved price/TB trends may not translate into durable revenue or margin gains, reducing forward visibility.
